name: Germany (Frankfurt/Hesse) Bank-Centre Holiday Calendar
comment: Frankfurt/Hesse weekday bank-centre convention (record CORE-CONVENTIONS-005 #3): the six TARGET closing days plus the national holidays Ascension, Whit Monday and Day of German Unity, Hesse's Corpus Christi, and the Bundesbank's additional non-business days December 24 and 31. Not a TARGET calendar: T2 and every euro payment system close only on TARGET days (use target2). German practice does not move a holiday that falls on a weekend. Easter offsets are counted from Easter Monday.

sources.name: Deutsche Bundesbank, Public holidays in Germany in 2027
